g.text: Figure 5b | Regional neural manifolds and Student-tested reciprocal-5NN profiles

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616b

g.text: 18 manifolds = 3 methods × 3 regions × 2 outcomes. Regional fits are independent; LFADS uses regional mPCs.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Success/failure reciprocal-5NN panels with Student tests (9)

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616b

g.text: Source-like reciprocal 5NN = 1 / mean distance to the five nearest event states on globally whitened latent axes 1–2; all states from the query trial are excluded. C/R/G/M = cue/reach/grasp/at-mouth. Filled bars: success; open bars: failure; error bars: query-trial bootstrap 95% CI. Brackets use

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616b

g.text: two-sided equal-variance Student t-tests: * Holm-adjusted P<0.05, ** P<0.01, *** P<0.001 within each method's 12 region-by-event comparisons. Success and failure use separate neighbor pools, so unequal outcome counts affect density and absolute scale. Method-specific levels cannot rank

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616b

g.text: methods; one mouse-day; outcome association is not causality.
